summary: Preserve a coherent distributed state and recover from worker loss without silently mixing steps or data positions.
outcomes: Define a consistent checkpoint boundary including optimizer, RNG and data position.
Distinguish restart, retry and elastic resharding assumptions.
sequence: List all state needed to reproduce a small distributed step.
Draw a consistent checkpoint boundary across ranks.
Separate device snapshots, host staging and durable publication.
Inject a controlled worker failure and recover.
Check resumed outputs and explain allowable nondeterminism.

visual.question: Does this checkpoint combine values from the same logical step?
visual.interaction: Interrupt publication at several stages and classify recoverable artifacts.

practice.task: Design and test a disposable two-worker restart workflow.
practice.success: Recovery rejects incomplete checkpoints and resumes a documented data/RNG position.
